title: Commerce — LLP 0063 exploratory transaction kernel
description: A claim-ineligible local kernel for server-trusted order pricing and final-unit inventory contention. It records a payment intent but performs no provider call.

backend.stalenessPolicy: committed; regenerate with codegen; freshness tracked by artifacts.json inputsHash

headlessLocalTransactionKernel: checkout arguments are closed over orderId and cannot carry money or quantity
order lines copy server-owned price/version facts
two buyers contending for the final unit produce one reservation and one payment intent
the loser leaves no partial reservation, attempt, or inventory decrement
cross-user order reads and checkout fail without disclosing order existence
invalid currency exponent and safe-integer overflow fail before order creation

capabilityGaps: hosted control plane and recovery drills
notClaiming: payment success, provider interoperability, PCI compliance, tax, or accounting
